In a connected business world, we are on the lookout for new colleagues to assist us in delivering connected flows and integrations for our customers. Building upon the business knowledge of our customers, you will translate their business/functional requirements into actual Boomi building blocks and processes to link their applications and business flows together.

What will your job look like as an Integration Engineer?

• Bridge the gap between business and IT
• Translate business and functional requirements into integration flows, technical solutions and architectural design
• Challenge both the requirements and solutions available for them
• Implement the business/IT flows into Boomi processes
• Implement Boomi processes and the customer environment in such a way that maintenance and support is manageable and feasible
• Stay aware of new possibilities and technologies

Who is our Integration Engineer?

Following knowledge is nice to have/required:

• Webservices
• SQL Language
• API Knowledge on different applications
• Experience in Integration Development is a nice to have
• Experience with Dell Boomi Development is a nice to have
• Fluent in Dutch and English

FURTHERMORE, YOU ARE:

• Result oriented and self-motivated
• Analytical thinking and have problem-solving skills
• Strong in communication and have interpersonal skills
• Accurate
• A good team player but able to work independently

In the ever-fascinating world of technology, integration opens endless possibilities. We are here to show companies how integration can empower their digital foundations and fuel business growth. And you have the chance to be at the forefront of the fascinating world of integration with us by joining us as an Integration Engineer.

Who are we?

Meet i8c! An established value within the integration market and part of CornerBriX, the largest integration community in Belgium. i8c is an expert in Hybrid Integration Platforms (HIP), ensuring seamless collaboration between all IT-systems like mobile apps, administrative tools, CRMs, ERPs, Microservices, SaaS platforms, B2B platforms and many more for leading companies in the BeNeLux region.

At i8c, you’ll find a community of integration experts who are here to challenge you, inspire you and support you. You'll always have the freedom to choose your work location, be it at home or one of our remote co-working spaces.

What will your job look like as an Integration Engineer at i8c:

• Take end-to-end ownership for i8c projects, handling development, deployment, and operational maintenance.
• You’ll embrace DevOps principles to achieve optimal uptime and minimize incidents. 
• You’ll learn to master multiple Hybrid Integration Platform (HIP) vendor solutions (IMB, Microsoft, Software AG, TIBCO, Google, Boomi…) establishing new standards and best practices.
• You’ll provide support on a rotational basis as part of a 24/7 standby team, ensuring prompt assistance when required.
• You’ll participate in daily standup meetings 

Who is our i8c Integration Engineer:

• We don't require extensive experience, but eagerness to deep dive into multiple hybrid integration platforms and technologies, such as Software AG webMethods, Tibco Connect, IBM App Connect/API Connect, Microsoft BizTalk and Azure, Google Apigee, and Boomi.
• You are fluent in English, both written as oral.
• You have basic programming experience with Java or .Net, with a focus on back-end development. 
• You are familiar with the concepts and principles of networking, security (DNS, firewalls, HTTP, SSL…) and DevOps (CI/CD, testing…)
• Knowledge of Enterprise Integration Patterns is a plus, just as experience with collaboration tools such as Atlassian, GitLab,…

Are you a finance enthusiast with a sharp mind for numbers and a proactive attitude? We are seeking a Treasury Assistant for a 6-month temporary contract (replacement mission) within a prominent financial institution located in the European Quarter of Brussels (1040). Reporting directly to the Head of Treasury, you will play a hands-on role in supporting treasury dealers with their daily market and operational activities.  
 

Main Responsibilities
 
 
 
• Money Market Operations: Executing bank-to-bank transfers and performing market transactions, specifically deposits.   
 
• Foreign Exchange (FX) Market: Processing currency exchange requests for clients, executing hedging operations, and closely monitoring market indicators (key meetings, interest rate forecasts, etc.).   
 
• Account & Flow Monitoring: Maintaining constant vigilance over internal account movements, managing incoming emails and requests, and providing prompt support to the Back Office.   
 
• Multichannel Communication: Handling multiple communication channels simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.   

 
 
•   
 
• Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Economics, Finance, or an equivalent field.   
 
• Experience: 2 to 3 years of experience, ideally within the banking or financial sector.   
 
• Languages: Business fluency in Italian, French, and English is required (listed by order of importance for daily operations).   
 
• IT Skills: Advanced proficiency in Excel (good level required) and familiarity with Bloomberg.   
 
• Soft Skills: You are proactive, dynamic, and possess a positive, social attitude. You are autonomous, excel at managing priorities, and can maintain your calm during intense, deadline-driven situations.   
 
•

What does your job as an Kafka Engineer look like:

• As an Kafka Engineer, you will provide advice on Event-Driven Architecture to our customers
• You'll translate EDA principles into technical designs and solutions
• Help our customers adopt Apache Kafka and related technologies
• Collaborate with other team members to ensure successful project delivery
• Stay up-to-date with industry developments
• Actively share knowledge within the i8c Community
• You will further grow as an integration expert with a focus on the EDA ecosystem (incl. Apache Kafka, Apache Pulsar, … )

What we expect from our Kafka Engineer:

• Thorough understanding of Event-Driven Architecture
• Thorough understanding of Enterprise Integration Concepts like; Application Integration, Messaging & API Management.
• Knowledge of data formats and standards like JSON, XML, OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, CloudEvents, Avro, Protobuf, Oauth2, …
• Experience with Apache Kafka
• Experience with Java
• Experience with Kubernetes (and/or Red Hat OpenShift)
• Experience with DevOps tooling like Tekton, Jenkins, ArgoCD, Terraform, …
• Experience with one or more integration platforms. (ex. Software AG webMethods ESB, Mulesoft Anypoint, IBM ACE, WSO2, TIBCO BusinessWorkx, Red Hat Fuse/Camel, … )
• Experience with a public cloud like AWS, Azure, and/or GCP.
• You’re fluently explaining your designs in English. Dutch and/or French is a plus

WHAT WOULD YOU DO?

In your role as a Data Engineer you provide insights and solutions for complex data problems in order to implement end-to-end data solutions. You are responsible for the implementation and maintenance of the Data Warehouse and ETL infrastructure, where you will transform data into useful data formats for analysis. As a Data Engineer you will come across many varied and challenging projects: ranging from the design and implementation of the data warehouse and the development of ETL to the implementation and maintenance of reports and dashboards.

WHO ARE YOU?

• You understand the needs of the customer and can easily handle complex data environments.
• You are focused on collaboration, innovation and continuous improvement.
• You have strong communication skills and always strive for the best solution.
• You have an inquisitive mind and eager to learn.
• You are fluent in Dutch or French and have a strong knowledge of English.

WHAT ABOUT YOUR TECHNICAL SKILLS?

• Knowledge and hands-on experience with ETL and Data pipelines to integrate multiple data sources
• Experience with Data Warehouse environments
• Insights in setting up ETL processes and Data Flows
• Development and testing of ETL jobs
• Solid programming skills and SQL querying experience
• Hands-on experience with ETL tools is a plus
• Knowledge of Data Vault, Kimball is a plus
• Knowledge of Oracle, Google BigQuery or Microsoft Azure is a plus

The Company

An industrial group active for several decades in the Brussels periphery, this company produces and markets technical equipment for a European professional client base. Finance is at the heart of operations, with flows crossing multiple countries and stakeholders that vary from one file to the next.

Around a hundred people on site, a well-organised accounting team and a work environment that values autonomy without leaving you on your own. The offices are located near Vilvoorde.

Your Responsibilities

You join the accounting team and take charge of the supplier and client cycle for several group entities.

• Processing and controlling purchase and sales invoices.
• Monitoring payments, reconciling accounts and matching third-party accounts.
• Managing client follow-ups and coordinating with suppliers in English and Dutch.
• Preparing VAT declarations and monitoring current regulatory obligations.
• Participating in monthly and annual closings in support of the team.
• Your responsibilities may evolve over time.

The Ideal Profile

Education : Bachelor's degree in accounting or equivalent through experience.

Experience : Minimum 3 years of experience in accounts payable and/or receivable. You are autonomous on day-to-day tasks and comfortable in a high-volume environment.

Technical skills : Good command of Excel. Knowledge of SAP is an asset.

Languages : Fluent Dutch and English are essential for smooth communication with various stakeholders.

Personal qualities

• Organised and reliable, you manage your priorities with method.
• Comfortable in both English and Dutch, you communicate effortlessly with a wide range of counterparts.
• You thrive in environments where you are trusted to work independently.

CE Driver Wanted in the Port of Antwerp

For a logistics company located in the Port of Antwerp, we are looking for an experienced and motivated CE Driver.

As a driver, you will be responsible for the safe and timely transport of bulk goods and containers to and from various locations in and around the port. You will join a professional transport environment where safety, punctuality and clear communication are key.

What will you do?

• You are responsible for container transport to and from the Port of Antwerp.
• You collect containers from terminals and deliver them to customers.
• You carry out national transport, mainly within Belgium and the surrounding region.
• You check the load and ensure that containers are properly and safely secured.
• You ensure the correct handling of transport documents.
• You stay in contact with the planning department and communicate any problems or delays.
• You comply with the applicable safety regulations in the port.
• You are responsible for the proper inspection and care of your truck and trailer.

You will mainly work from the Port of Antwerp and carry out predominantly national and regional routes.

Interested?

Apply today and discover whether this position as a CE Driver in the Port of Antwerp is the right opportunity for you!

REF: MEC1

• You have a valid CE driving licence and Code 95
• Previous experience with container transport is preferred.
• Experience driving in the Port of Antwerp is a strong advantage.
• An  ADR certificate is a strong advantage.
• You are a safe and responsible driver.
• You are punctual, reliable and customer-oriented.
• You can work independently, while communicating smoothly with the planning department.
• You are flexible and have no problem with the dynamic nature of port and transport work.
• You have a sufficient level of  English to communicate smoothly.

For our client, a company based in Lokeren and active in the foam processing industry, we are looking for an operator.
 

As an operator, you will be responsible for accurately cutting and preparing foam rubber. You ensure that every order meets the required dimensions, shape, and quality standards.
 

Your responsibilities 

- Set up and operate cutting machines and closely monitor the production process. 

- Check the dimensions and quality of the products. 

- Read technical drawings and cutting plans and accurately translate them into practice. 

- Carry out minor maintenance on the machines and independently resolve simple first-line breakdowns. 

- Keep your workplace clean, organised, and safe, and work in accordance with the applicable safety guidelines.

- You speak English very well. 

- You have spatial and technical insight and are strong in math. 

- You work accurately and independently. 

- You are stress-resistant and have a strong sense of responsibility.

Are you looking for a meaningful job where you contribute daily to improving the lives of patients with life-threatening diseases? As a Lab Technician you will work with a passionate team to develop groundbreaking therapies and make a real difference for patients worldwide.
 

Your key responsibilities:
 

 
• Work daily in a Class A/B/C/D cleanroom environment and maintain the cleanliness of equipment and facilities.
 
• Produce clinical and commercial ATMPs through aseptic manual processes, including cell isolation, selection, activation, transduction, culture, filling & finishing, and cryopreservation.
 
• Perform in-process control tests on batch samples, ensuring high standards for cell counts and viability.
 
• Ensure equipment operates smoothly by following instructions, troubleshooting issues, and coordinating repairs.
 
• Contribute to process optimization, including the introduction of new products, procedures, and equipment in GMP areas.
 
• Support the writing and review of SOPs and other production-related documents, and manage raw materials, consumables, and waste. 

Who we are looking for:
 

 
• You have obtained a Bachelor's degree in Sciences, Bio-Engineering, Biotechnology, Pharmacy, or a related field, or possess equivalent experience.
 
• Cell culture experience (internship or work-based) is a strong plus. 
 
• Knowledge of GMP regulations is a strong plus.
 
• Strong interpersonal skills with a focus on teamwork are required.
 
• Clear communication in English with attention to detail.
 
• Strong problem-solving abilities with a positive attitude.
 
• Motivated to learn independently and coach others.
 
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.

As an Operations Expert, you'll play a key role in manufacturing advanced cell therapies that are transforming cancer treatment and giving patients new hope.
 

Every day, your work will directly contribute to delivering life-changing therapies to patients facing serious diseases. Join a passionate team united by a shared purpose: creating innovative treatments and improving lives around the world.

Office Manager (Part-time or Full-time)
 

At Astrape Networks, we’re building the future of sustainable data center solutions. To support our growing team, we’re looking for an experienced, hands-on Office Manager who enjoys ownership, variety, and making things run smoothly behind the scenes.
 

In this key role, you’ll be the backbone of our daily operations: managing our office in Schelle, assisting the management team, and handling a broad range of tasks. 
 

Fluency in English and Dutch is required. The role is based in Schelle, with occasional travel to our Eindhoven office (few times/month).
 

The role can be filled on a 60%, 80% or 100% basis, depending on your preference and availability.
 

How You’ll Make an Impact
 

Office & Facilities
 
 

• Manage daily office operations in Schelle and support the Eindhoven office 

• Coordinate supplies, furniture, maintenance, vendors, and deliveries 

• Own purchasing from request to delivery and issue resolution 

• Handle practical matters such as lunch orders, visitors, and mail  

Administrative & Executive Support
 
 

• Coordinate meetings, events, travel and expenses 

• Prepare and maintain documents and administrative records 

• Manage correspondence, the central mailbox, and internal trackers  

HR & People Support
 
 

• Coordinate onboarding, ensuring equipment and tools are ready from day one 

• Schedule interviews and support candidate communication 

• Provide practical HR and employee support as needed 

Who You Are
 
 

• An experienced Office Manager in a fast-paced environment 

• Highly organized, proactive, and comfortable handling a broad and diverse task set 

• Hands-on, reliable, and able to stay calm when priorities shift 

• Fluent in English and Dutch;  

• Strong administrative skills, with experience in document handling, scheduling, and order processing 

• Ideally living within reasonable distance of Schelle and open to occasional travel to Eindhoven

jobs.occupation: Worker in Digital Print - 2 Shifts - Waregem
jobs.description:
Have you always been interested in the world of graphic design? Do you already have experience from previous jobs or studies? Do you live in the Waregem area? 
Then we're looking for you!

We're looking for a Worker in Digital Print for a company that specialises in certified labels. 

What are your tasks? 

• Working with modern digital printing presses
• Refilling materials in the machines
• Carrying out quality checks (colour, finish, quality)
• Preparing print jobs using digital files
• Minor maintenance 

Who are you?

• You have knowledge of graphic design or pressing machines
• You speak English, French or Dutch
• You have your own transport
• You are precise and hard-working

Do you have a technical mindset?Are you passionate about machines and technology? Do you live near Waregem? 
Then this opportunity is for you!

For a leading company specialized in certified labels, we are looking for a Technical Operator in 2 Shifts or a Fixed Morning Shift!

What are your tasks?

• Operating complex machines on the production line
• Setting temperatures
• Setting parameters
• Filling machines with very precise quantities of materials
• Adhering to strict safety regulations

Who are you?

• You have a strong technical background, gained through education or work experience. 
• You speak Nederlands or English.
• You have your own transport.
• Experience in this sector is a plus!

Responsibilities:

At this position, your tasks will be highly varied. One day you might be performing (preventive) maintenance on industrial compressors, while the next you could be conducting complex repairs on a generator. In short, you'll have plenty of technical challenges and day-to-day variety.

• Conduct maintenance and repairs on rental equipment such as diesel generators and compressors to ensure optimal performance and safety

• Perform scheduled inspections and preventive maintenance routines to guarantee fleet reliability

• Troubleshoot technical issues, including mechanical and electrical problems, on site or in the workshop

• Prepare equipment efficiently after use to ensure readiness for the next customer

• Document maintenance activities and communicate technical findings clearly to team members and clients

• At least 2/3 years as a workshop technician/ engineer
• Bachelor’s degree in electromechanics or a related technical field
• Strong knowledge of diesel engines, compressors, and electrical systems, including reading electrical diagrams 
• Fluency in English, with excellent communication skills for technical discussions and documentation
• Proven problem solving skills, results oriented mindset, and the ability to work independently or in a team
• Flexibility regarding working hours and a proactive attitude toward continuous learning and development

Unique Antwerp Maritime is looking for a Crew Planner. You will be working for one of our clients, one of the largest offshore pipeline installation and subsea construction companies, located in Essen.
 

In this role, you will take full responsibility for crew planning within your assigned disciplines. You ensure everything runs smoothly — from long-term workforce planning to last-minute solutions.
 

Your responsibilities include:
 
 
 
• Creating and managing crew schedules for personnel on board our vessels 
 
• Acting as the point of contact for superintendents, captains, and shore-based colleagues 
 
• Collaborating closely with HR, Operations, and the crew members themselves 
 
• Taking into account experience, certifications, and project requirements 
 
• Identifying shortages or surpluses in staffing and contributing to solutions 
 
• Ensuring a fair distribution of experience and opportunities within teams 
 
• Discussing career growth and development opportunities for crew members together with HR 
 

In short: you maintain oversight in a dynamic environment where no two days are the same.

What matters to us? Your curiosity, drive, and enjoyment of what you do. It’s a big plus if you also bring:
 
 
 
• At least 3 to 5 years of experience in a similar role, such as crew planning or transport planning 
 
• The ability to stay calm and maintain an overview, even when everything happens at once 
 
• Clear and friendly communication skills, with a good sense of humor 
 
• The confidence to make decisions and take responsibility, always with respect and situational awareness 
 
• Fluency in spoken and written English; knowledge of Dutch is a plus 
 
• A willingness to travel occasionally, for example to vessels or our office in Delft

jobs.employer_name: BIO BASE EUROPE PILOT PLANT VZW
jobs.description:
As a Bio Process Technician at BBEPP, you choose a job that is truly different. You will work with a team of engineers and technicians on a wide variety of innovative projects. No routine work, but an inspiring environment where you gain new insights, deepen your expertise, and further develop your talents. Together with your colleagues, you scale up and optimize bio-based processes (from lab to industrial scale) that contribute to a sustainable bio-economy and to solutions for today’s and tomorrow’s climate challenges.

In the role of a Bio Process Technician, you are responsible for preparing processes and setting up (pre-) industrial pilot installations. In addition to setting up these test installations, you will also carry out the different process steps and operate the corresponding equipment. In consultation with the process engineers, you closely monitor the process parameters of the scale-up processes assigned to you (fermentation, biocatalysis, purification). You regularly take samples, analyse them in the lab, and critically evaluate the results, actively contributing ideas for potential improvements. Moreover, you act as a true ambassador for safety, structure, and hygiene in the process environment.

We're looking for a motivated weekend employee (2 x 12-hour nights per week + 2 x 8-hour days per month). You're a hands-on technician with a no-nonsense mentality who enjoys actively participating in innovative bio-based processes.

You work independently, methodically, and accurately, and you have knowledge of biotechnological processes such as fermentation or biocatalysis, or experience in process industry, chemistry, or food. Experience with bio-based products and processes is a plus. You are a real team player and communicate fluently in both Dutch and English.

The ideal candidate holds a bachelor’s degree in chemistry, biochemistry, HBO5 chemistry/biochemistry, or a laboratory technician diploma. In this case, previous work experience is not required. If you already have experience in the process industry, chemistry, or food sector, an A2 diploma (secondary education) in a scientific or technical field is also sufficient.

Nobody is perfect, at Bio Base Europe Pilot Plant, there is plenty of room to learn by doing! Can’t check every box above, but are you flexible, eager to learn, and open to tailored training? Do you enjoy taking on challenges, with a healthy dose of pioneer spirit running through your veins? Then don’t hesitate to get in touch!

YOUR ROLE
 

You will work at our Umamido & RORU Atelier — a dedicated production facility combining a professional kitchen and warehouse. We are looking for a temporary team member for a 6-month period, from September to January, to strengthen our production team during our peak season. You will be part of the production and logistics operations behind our restaurants, working in a hands-on environment where kitchen work and warehouse activities come together.
 

Your responsibilities will include:
 

• 
 Receiving deliveries and checking quantities and product quality.
 

• 
 Storing products correctly and ensuring the warehouse remains organised.
 

• 
 Keeping your workspace clean and following HACCP food safety standards.
 

• 
 Taking an active role in food production and preparation, including:
 

○ Meat and seafood
 

○ Vegetables
 

○ Sauces, marinades, and toppings
 

• 
 Preparing and packaging finished products according to our guidelines.
 

• 
 Ensuring products are properly prepared and packed for safe and fresh transport to our different restaurants.
 

This is a hands-on production role, combining kitchen preparation, food handling, packaging, and warehouse activities. You will be working at the heart of the operations that support our restaurants every day — where quality, teamwork, efficiency, and craftsmanship come together.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR
 

· 
 You enjoy working in a production kitchen and warehouse environment and don’t mind rolling up your sleeves.
 

· 
 You are detail-oriented and have a strong focus on quality and food safety.
 

· 
 You enjoy a hands-on role that combines food production and warehouse activities.
 

· 
 You communicate fluently in English, Dutch, or French.
 

· 
 You are available for the 6-month period from September to January.
 

· 
 You enjoy being part of a collaborative and positive team environment.
